correctness.rationale: The exact quandle operation on binary residue/fiber coordinates is (v,w)*(s,t)=(v,w+v+s); displacement translations force each automorphism to be (Tv+a,Tw+u_v) with T invertible and arbitrary fiber shifts. Condition on fixed-space dimension d and K=2^d: an affine quotient has K fixed fibers with probability 1/K, and independently each fiber has K fixed points with probability 1/K, giving H_K(z)=1-1/K+(1/K)(1-1/K+z^K/K)^K. Gaussian-binomial moment inversion derives p_{r,d} and q-series Euler product gives p_infty,d; a uniform Markov tail bound justifies total distribution convergence. Independently enumerated automorphisms in rank 2 confirm histogram 0:2769,1:2048,2:768,4:492,8:54,12:12,16:1 of 6144 and rank-3 GL fixed-space counts 48,98,21,1. Finite checks do not establish infinite-rank assertions.
